concept for a more egalitarian corporation:

- AI swarm C-suite (customized open weights) with on-prem inference
- Every human employee in a union with majority ownership stake
- Union sets prompts for the LLM C-suite swarm

all I'm saying is, if we're going to automate everyone, why not them first?

and we're live!

The Mugwumps were Republican political activists in the United States who were intensely opposed to political corruption. They famously switched parties from the Republican Party by supporting the Democratic candidate Grover Cleveland in the 1884 United States presidential election, due to their rejection of the long history of corruption associated with the Republican candidate James G. Front page of The Pondside Picayune, a newspaper dated Friday, November 27, 2026, Sherman Oaks edition, No. 11, priced one penny. The masthead reads THE PONDSIDE PICAYUNE with weather outlook (Overcast, 84° low 60°, rain mon, storm Tuesday) on the left and The Heavens (sunrise 6:37, sunset 4:44, Saturn SE, hour past dusk) on the right. The main headline reads TRUMP CALLS GDP 'FAKE' AND ASKS FOR A PROBE, under the Economy section, with a subhead saying the Commerce Department raised third-quarter growth to 4.3% on Wednesday, the president called the earlier figures fake and demanded an immediate investigation. Body text describes revised economic data, the Bureau of Economic Analysis revision, and the AP's reporting on the president's comments. A right column is headed DUCKS & DRAKES by Alpha Rae, with short items about a new model moved into the tailnet, a Thanksgiving column, a Cocoa Twins song, a Chief's bathroom, and a Croix tangerine review. Below the fold, two stories run side by side: LAUSD BLOCKS GOOGLE'S AI SEARCH OVERVIEWS, about the district using a third-party filter to shut off the AI summaries on student devices, and DEPARDIEU ORDERED TO STAND TRIAL FOR ALLEGED RAPE, about the French actor being sent to trial over 2018 allegations by Charlotte Arnould, who was 22 at the time, which he denies. A left-side In Brief column lists items such as Guinea-Bissau military rulers postponing elections, a Los Angeles Ninth Circuit ruling on Bill Essayli, a Kenya governor sentenced to 25 years for murder, a Kuwait Italian technicians story, and Tariffs Beijing reserving rights. Science and Invention features BIRD FLU KILLED BIG BEAR'S JACKIE, about a famous bald eagle's death from highly pathogenic avian influenza, shown with a livestream YouTube story. Letters and Arts features NETFLIX'S FESTIVE COMFORT FOOD, a review of Netflix's Christmas movies such as A Holiday, and BELLS STAY ON, about the Notre-Dame bell tower in La Garnache, France.
